## Cost Sharing Requirements

Anthem works with doctors, Hospitals, Pharmacies and other healthcare Providers to control healthcare costs.  As part of this effort, most Providers who contract with Anthem agree to control costs by giving discounts to Anthem.  Most other insurers maintain similar arrangements with Providers.

The contracts between Anthem and Our In Network Providers include a 'hold harmless' clause which provides that You cannot be held responsible by the Provider for claims owed by Anthem for healthcare services covered under this Plan.
